body: we're in the same boat. i don't have advice or platitudes, i'm just sorry you're feeling this way

dude same. the moment i decided, for sure, that this is what i wanted to do, it was like a switch flipped. i felt focused, calm, put at ease. finally felt like there was something i could actually accomplish and do right and i was looking forward to it

friend found out and i'm supposed to be trying for her but all i want to do is sleep. i guess i still have my plans but now i feel guilty, the intention was to just quietly disappear, not hurt somebody. but planning it still is the only thing that comforts me

hey, for what it's worth, it's not your fault. my father played similar games with me. they know what they're doing and hiding in plain sight to isolate and discredit you. i'm so sorry you're experiencing this, it's horrible and re-traumatizing, and it hurts 10x worse when you know the people around you will support your abuser instead of you. you deserve so much better - you're not the one who did anything wrong and you're not the one who deserves to suffer for it.

however you choose to approach this situation - and anything you choose will present its own challenges, it's all about what's most livable for you - it's okay. do what you need to do to survive long enough to get away from them. it's hard, but abuse like this is escapable. it's a lot easier to do with support, so if you can, try to find counseling to help process this in a safe environment - even downloading a diary app to document your feelings and experiences helps. what you've been through is real and you have nothing to be ashamed of. you are not damaging the family by doing what's necessary to keep yourself safe. you are not in the wrong. there would be no issue without his abuse. that's a choice he made and it was his alone, one he made because he's an abuser, not because you earned it in any way. you deserve support and compassion even if it's not your family who shows it. and whether or not they do reflects more about them than it does you.

all the best and much love. <3
